name: Mitsui Takuya
source: Dr. Mitsui is the head of the pediactrics division at the hospital. He is an elite doctor whom grandfather is a chairman on the Board of Directors for the hospital. Although he has many women admirers due to his appearance and status, he treats them very coldly; he seems to have more of a liking for the young boys he sees in the hospital ward.
